reason: I'd sign up for the free plan tonight, because getting my evenings back is exactly what I want. But I won't pay 99 a month until I've seen it answer my customer emails without embarrassing me. And 50 credits total probably isn't enough to show me that in the first month.
objection: Our CRM is a mess nobody updates, so I doubt an AI can 'learn my business' from it. I'd end up checking and fixing everything it does, which costs me hours instead of saving them. I also have no idea how far 100 credits a month actually goes.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial of the full Standard plan for 14 days with enough credits to run my real support inbox, plus a clear explanation of what one credit buys.
